highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: The vulnpocalypse rains iBugs down on Apple with record-setting number of patches and Acronis warns of actively exploited flaw in its cPanel backup plugin. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Malcious Admin Menu Editor Pro plugin backdoors 1,500 WordPress sites. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: CenterPoint Energy confirms customer data stolen in cyberattack. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
